metadata.title: Tesla’s China Sales Hit Lowest Since 2022. What It Means for Year-End Targets.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla’s China Sales Hit Lowest Since 2022. What It Means for Year-End Targets.
The Chinese car market is terrible. Tesla’s latest results show just how weak the world’s largest market for new cars and new EVs is these days.
